blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — China-based C&U Group is investing $87 million (P5.2 billion) to develop a planned industrial park in Batangas province, its largest overseas manufacturing hub. The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) said the Chinese bearings manufacturer’s multimillion-dollar investment covers the first phase of a planned industrial park in the municipality of Alitagtag.
